topology_evidence: Official registered person fits exported with stable original vertex IDs, 6890 vertices and identical 13776 faces. Counts alone are not independent proof of canonical vertex ordering; source is standard SMPL-family registration and remeshing/reordering must be excluded.

protocol.freeze_requirement: Scoring permitted only after prediction artifact SHA and inference settings frozen by root; separate evaluator, reference never enters inference or fitting.
protocol.main_prediction: raw incam SMPL-X vertices transformed using calibrated c2w; no scale/rigid/Procrustes alignment
protocol.secondary_prediction: official postproc incam from identical image features; independent saved artifact; do not use own GV0 global as calibrated world
protocol.reference_regression: J_ref[t] = regressor @ original reference xyz_world[t], unchanged regressor
protocol.prediction_regression: J_pred[t] = regressor @ smplx2smpl @ world_vertices_smplx[t], use same unchanged matrices
metrics: Absolute Euclidean joint error (mean/median/p90/max), all 17 COCO joints
Absolute 12-body joint error, indices 5..16; face/eye/ear excluded as fixed anatomy subset
Left/right/mean wrist absolute errors, COCO indices 9/10; not glove surface
Hip midpoint absolute error, mean(COCO11,COCO12); position component
Hip-midpoint-relative 12-body error, subtract own and reference hip midpoint separately; diagnostic only, not absolute reconstruction metric
14-time displacement relative to first matched sample, all17/body12/wrists; anchored displacement, not free trajectory alignment
protocol.time: Use fixed 14 input indices, no interpolation into114-frame GT; record nominal and matched real timestamps. Any velocity proxy is coarse interval and timing-uncertain.
protocol.no_confidence_selection: Score all predetermined reference frames/joints without dropping low-confidence predictions; report invalids explicitly.
limitations: Registered fitted proxy, not sensor ground truth
May include template-completed hidden body regions
Joint centres differ from prior glove-surface queries; scores not comparable to MoSca hand query error
At most one scene prior-quality gate; no established cross-scene improvement
Nominal/RGB offsets up to103.745ms do not certify multisensor synchronization
